verdict.rationale: A probe confirms llms.txt is live at https://docs.bolna.ai/llms.txt returning HTTP 200 with structured doc links, directly enabling an agent to consume agent-oriented docs; this is further supported by Bolna also offering an official MCP server for AI assistants to interact with the docs/account. Missing for 10: no independent third-party confirmation of an agent actually consuming and acting on llms.txt content.
